papers.title: Reversible liquid-phase lithium transfer across the battery lifecycle
papers.abstract_en: This Review highlights lithium–arene complexes (LACs) as versatile liquid lithium sources and establishes the PAH/LAC pair as a reversible lithium carrier, enabling lithium extraction and donation across the battery lifecycle.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬-아렌 착물(LAC)을 가역적인 액상 리튬 운반체로 제안하는 리뷰 논문이다. 다환방향족탄화수소(PAH)/LAC 쌍이 배터리 수명 전주기에서 리튬을 추출하고 공급하는 매개체로 작동할 수 있음을 제시한다.

papers.title: Multi-Anion Competitive Solvation: Unlocking Wide-Temperature Anode-Free Sodium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Anode-free sodium metal batteries (AFSMBs) promise high energy density and low cost but suffer from irreversible sodium loss, particularly under extreme temperatures where sluggish desolvation kinetics and unstable interfacial chemistry...
papers.summary_ko: 무음극(anode-free) 소듐 금속전지는 저온·고온 환경에서 탈용매화 속도 저하와 불안정한 계면 화학으로 소듐 손실이 발생하는 문제가 있다. 본 연구는 다중 음이온 경쟁적 용매화 전략을 통해 넓은 온도 범위에서 무음극 소듐 금속전지의 가역성을 향상시켰다.

papers.title: Anode-free configurations through separator-mediated interfacial regulation for practical sodium metal batteries
papers.abstract_en: Functionally engineered separators regulate Na + transport and interfacial chemistry. They homogenize ion flux, stabilize the SEI, and suppress dendrites to improve reversibility, especially in anode-free sodium metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 무음극 소듐 금속전지의 실용화를 위해 분리막 매개 계면 조절 전략을 제시한 연구이다. 기능화된 분리막이 Na+ 이동을 균일화하고 SEI를 안정화하며 덴드라이트를 억제하여 가역성을 개선한다.

papers.title: Spike Sintering Tailored to Scrap Black Mass with a Low‐Defect Crystal Structure for Direct Single‐Crystal Upcycling of Layered Cathode Materials
papers.abstract_en: Direct upcycling of black mass into single‐crystal cathodes relies on calcination for several hours. Here, spike sintering (SS) is shown to convert scrap black mass (SBM) into single‐crystal cathodes with an isothermal hold of only 1 min at 1040°C. SBM permits this because its lattice remains largely intact, with a lithium deficiency of 3% and an antisite occupancy of 4.52%, comparable to 4.26% for a pristine commercial NCM523. The thermal cycle combines Li restoration and partial recovery of cation order with grain growth, which temperature accelerates exponentially. The upcycled cathode (U‐NCM) forms grain‐boundary‐free single particles with 3.89% antisite occupancy and doubled fracture strength. Relative to the conventional 950°C 5 h protocol, SS reduces the total furnace residence time, including the ramp, from 486 to 205 min and eliminates 99.7% of the isothermal hold. In graphite pouch full cells at 4.5 V and 45°C, U‐NCM retains 76.9 ± 1.5% after 350 cycles compared with 51.5 ± 15.3% for commercial polycrystalline NCM523 (three cells each). Matching the thermal protocol to the crystallographic state of the feedstock therefore enables single‐crystal upcycling within a 1 min isothermal hold, demonstrated here for NCM523 scrap black mass from a single industrial source.
papers.summary_ko: 폐배터리 흑색분말(black mass)을 짧은 등온 유지시간(1040°C, 1분)으로 스파이크 소결하여 결함이 적은 단결정 NCM523 양극재로 직접 업사이클링하는 방법을 제시했다. 기존 950°C·5시간 공정 대비 가열시간을 486분에서 205분으로 줄이면서도, 재생된 단결정 NCM523이 4.5V/45°C 풀셀에서 350사이클 후 76.9% 용량 유지율을 보여 기존 다결정 NCM523(51.5%)보다 우수한 성능을 나타냈다.

papers.title: Scalable 3D hybrid integrated photonic computing chiplets
papers.abstract_en: The exponential surge in artificial intelligence computing power demand is driving a transition from electrons to photons across the infrastructure. Although integrated photonics has revolutionized communications and computing, its scaling for large-scale information processing is constrained by monolithic scalability, modulation efficiency, and multi-chip integration. Here, we present HyPec, a hybrid photonic extensible chiplet architecture that synergizes thin-film lithium niobate modulation chiplets with femtosecond laser-written three-dimensional functional chiplets. Through function disaggregation, HyPec partitions high-performance active modulation from the 3D photonic routing network. This chiplet architecture facilitates seamless multi-chip connectivity across diverse material platforms to achieve aggregate performance beyond monolithic limits, thereby allowing the system to scale through the addition of functional chiplets. To validate the advantages of this architecture, we experimentally built a co-packaged photonic computing chiplet system that implements a scalable graph solver and further identifies critical protein residues in structural biology networks. This work establishes a scalable hardware path for integrated photonic computing, with broader implications for high-density optical interconnects and photonic quantum information systems.
papers.summary_ko: 박막 리튬나이오베이트 변조 칩렛과 3차원 펨토초 레이저 광학 배선을 결합한 하이브리드 포토닉 컴퓨팅 칩렛 아키텍처(HyPec)를 제시한 연구로, 배터리와는 무관한 집적광학 컴퓨팅 분야 논문이다.

papers.title: Resolving Dual‐Electrode Instability of Acetonitrile Electrolytes in Graphite||LiNi 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 Batteries via Anion Solvation Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Acetonitrile (AN) is a promising electrolyte solvent for high‐power lithium‐ion batteries (LIBs) owing to its high dielectric constant and low viscosity. However, its practical application is hindered by poor reductive stability at the graphite anode and an often‐overlooked detrimental interaction with high‐nickel cathodes. Here, we demonstrate that replacing LiPF 6 with LiBF 4 in a fluoroethylene carbonate (FEC)/methyl acetate (MA)/AN ternary solvent system yields a high‐performance electrolyte (LBF), resolving both challenges simultaneously. The BF 4 − anion reconstructs Li + solvation structure by forming abundant contact ion pairs and aggregates, effectively displacing AN from primary solvation sheath and suppressing its reductive decomposition at the anode. Concurrently, BF 4 − undergoes preferential oxidation at the cathode to generate a robust, boron‐rich cathode electrolyte interphase that inhibits transition metal dissolution from LiNi 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 (NCM811) lattice. 1.6 Ah graphite||NCM811 pouch cells employing the LBF exhibit high rate capability (capacity retention of 85.1% at 5C and 54.0% at 7C), stable cycling (75.2% retention after 500 cycles), drastically reduced gas evolution (87.6% lower than baseline), and reliable low‐temperature operation (99.7% retention after 200 cycles at −20°C and 55.4% capacity delivery at −40°C). This work establishes anion‐directed solvation engineering as an effective strategy for stabilizing both electrode interfaces in AN‐based electrolyte systems.
papers.summary_ko: 아세토니트릴(AN) 전해질은 흑연 음극에서의 환원 안정성 저하와 고니켈 양극과의 유해한 상호작용이 문제였다. 본 연구는 LiPF6를 LiBF4로 대체한 FEC/MA/AN 삼원 전해질(LBF)을 통해 BF4- 음이온이 Li+ 용매화 구조를 재구성, 음극에서 AN 환원분해를 억제하고 NCM811 양극 표면에 붕소가 풍부한 CEI를 형성시켜 전이금속 용출을 억제함을 보였다. 1.6Ah 흑연||NCM811 파우치셀에서 5C 85.1%, 500사이클 후 75.2% 용량유지율 등 향상된 성능을 달성했다.

papers.title: Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy (Capecitabine‐Based) Followed by CAPOX Consolidation, With Versus Without PD‐1 Blockade, in pMMR/MSS Ultra‐Low Rectal Cancer Patients (CHOICE II): A Multi‐Center, Open‐Label, Randomized Controlled Trial
papers.abstract_en: Importance A single‐arm trial reported 43% clinical complete response (cCR) with neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy (nCRT) plus sintilimab in pMMR/MSS ultra‐low rectal cancer; this trial compares nCRT with and without sintilimab in this population. Objective To compare the cCR rate in pMMR/MSS ultra‐low rectal cancer patients receiving nCRT with or without sintilimab. Design, setting, and participants This multicenter, open‐label randomized trial enrolled 180 patients with cT 1‐3a N 0‐1 M 0 pMMR/MSS rectal adenocarcinoma (inferior margin ≤ 5 cm) at 11 Chinese centers (July 2022–December 2024). Interventions Patients received nCRT (50 Gy plus capecitabine), then two CAPOX cycles, with or without sintilimab. Main outcomes and measures The primary endpoint was initial cCR after neoadjuvant therapy (mITT); secondary endpoints included organ preservation, pCR, overall complete response, DFS, and OS. Results The mITT population included 85 sintilimab and 84 nCRT patients. Initial cCR was 36.5% vs. 17.9% (ARD 18.6%, 95% CI 5.5%–31.7%; RR 2.04, 95% CI 1.19–3.50; p = 0.007). pCR was 25.0% vs. 15.7% (p = 0.249); overall CR was 50.6% vs. 27.4% (p = 0.002). Adverse events (72.9% vs 64.3%; p = 0.225) were similar. Survival data were immature. Conclusion and relevance Adding sintilimab to nCRT increased the rate of cCR in patients with pMMR/MSS ultra‐low rectal cancer. Trial Registration ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT05215379
papers.summary_ko: pMMR/MSS 초저위 직장암 환자에서 신보강화학방사선요법 후 PD-1 억제제(신틸리맙) 병용 여부를 비교한 다기관 무작위 임상시험으로, 배터리와 무관한 임상의학 논문이다.

papers.title: Low-pressure operation of all-solid-state batteries enabled by an organic electrode
papers.abstract_en: All-solid-state batteries offer enhanced safety and high energy density. However, their practical application is challenged by the need for high external pressures, often tens of MPa, to maintain intimate solid–solid contact and preserve ion/electron percolation pathways during cycling. In this work, we demonstrate that low-modulus, low-hardness, creep-compliant, low-strain organic active materials that readily deform in response to external pressures and microstructural changes enable stable cell operation under low stack pressures. Using bis-tetraaminobenzoquinone (TAQ) as a model compound, we show its low modulus (8.4–15.3 GPa), low hardness (0.33–0.76 GPa), and moderate creep compliance ( m = 0.038–0.073), quantified by nanoindentation of both pristine and lithiated TAQ, enable adaptive deformability under low stack pressures. TAQ-based solid-state cells achieve stable cycling and promising rate performance at external pressures as low as 1 MPa, retaining 80.3% capacity after 100 cycles at 0.5C. Operando and post-mortem electron microscopy reveal that TAQ electrodes maintain high structural integrity at pressures as low as 0.2 MPa. These findings establish a materials design strategy centered on mechanically adaptive materials to enable solid-state battery operation under practically relevant pressure conditions.
papers.summary_ko: 전고체전지는 안정적인 고체-고체 접촉을 위해 수십 MPa의 높은 외부 압력이 필요한 문제가 있다. 본 연구는 저탄성·저경도의 유기 활물질 비스-테트라아미노벤조퀴논(TAQ)을 이용하여 1MPa 수준의 낮은 압력에서도 100사이클 후 80.3% 용량유지율을 보이는 안정적인 전고체전지 작동을 구현했다. 나노인덴테이션과 오퍼란도 전자현미경 분석을 통해 TAQ 전극이 저압에서도 구조적 완전성을 유지함을 확인했다.

papers.title: Localized High-Concentration Electrolyte with Nonfluorinated Diluent for Wide-Temperature Sodium-Ion Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Localized high-concentration electrolytes (LHCEs) have been extensively investigated to improve rechargeable battery performance, yet most rely on costly fluorinated diluents. Herein, we develop a 1M LHCE using toluene as nonfluorinated and low-cost diluent for wide-temperature sodium-ion batteries (SIBs). The 1M LHCE features a compressed solvation structure and preserved ion-transport pathways, enabling the antimonene alloy anode to deliver stable capacities of 555.2 mAh g–1 over 600 cycles at 25 °C and 573.2 and 512.3 mAh g–1 at 50 and –20 °C, respectively. Na3V2(PO4)3//antimonene full cells further demonstrate stable operation under 50 and –20 °C. Mechanistic investigations reveal that the 1M LHCE forms an adaptive solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) that dynamically regulates composition and thickness, which becomes thicker and more organic-rich after sodiation but thinner and more inorganic-rich after desodiation. Such “breathable” SEI effectively accommodates large volume changes and ensures efficient Na+ transport. This work provides a rational electrolyte design strategy for wide-temperature SIBs.
papers.summary_ko: 기존 국부고농도전해질(LHCE)은 비싼 불화 희석제에 의존하는 한계가 있어, 본 연구는 저가의 비불화 희석제인 톨루엔을 사용한 1M LHCE를 넓은 온도범위 소듐이온전지용으로 개발했다. 압축된 용매화 구조와 유지된 이온전달 경로를 통해 안티모넨 합금 음극이 25°C에서 600사이클간 555.2 mAh/g, -20~50°C에서도 안정적인 용량을 보였으며 Na3V2(PO4)3//안티모넨 풀셀에서도 극온 안정성을 입증했다. 사이클 중 '숨쉬는' SEI가 부피변화를 수용하고 Na+ 전달을 돕는 것으로 분석되었다.

papers.title: Lithium coordination compound reduces nephrotoxicity and enhances therapeutic effects in Alzheimer’s disease female mice
papers.abstract_en: Lithium holds therapeutic promise for Alzheimer’s disease (AD), yet its clinical application is hindered by a narrow therapeutic range and nephrotoxicity. We rationally design a lithium coordination compound, BuLiPro, chelated with endogenous butyrate and proline. Single-crystal diffraction and mass-spectrometry confirm its crystal structure and solution-state coordination, while spectroscopic assays verify an identity distinct from free lithium. Compared with lithium carbonate, BuLiPro achieves improved plasma exposure, slower clearance, and 61.6%-higher brain lithium accumulation at 48 h in rats. It yields lower renal cytotoxicity and in vivo kidney injury, and inhibits glycogen synthase kinase-3β over three-fold more potently. In female AD model mice, BuLiPro attenuates tau and amyloid-β pathologies to a greater extent and rescues cognition. This coordination-based strategy enhances lithium’s central bioavailability and reduces systemic toxicity, offering a framework for the development of next-generation lithium therapeutics.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬은 알츠하이머병 치료 가능성이 있으나 신독성과 좁은 치료범위가 문제다. 본 연구는 부티레이트와 프롤린으로 킬레이트화한 리튬 배위화합물(BuLiPro)을 설계하여 뇌 내 리튬 축적을 높이고 신장 독성을 낮추는 결과를 제시했으며, 배터리와는 무관한 생의학 논문이다.

papers.title: Ion‐Pair Mediation Enables Low‐Viscosity, Nonflammable Ternary Hybrid Electrolytes for High‐Voltage Aqueous Zinc Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Aqueous zinc metal batteries (AZMBs) have garnered attention as promising energy storage devices owing to their intrinsic safety. However, the practical energy density of AZMBs is severely constrained by the narrow electrochemical window and sluggish kinetics inherent to conventional concentrated or viscous aqueous electrolytes. To address these limitations, a ternary hybrid system comprising a Zn(OTf) 2 /LiOTf dual‐salt matrix and low‐volume (5 vol.%) 1‐ethyl‐3‐methylimidazolium bis(trifluoromethylsulfonyl)imide (EMIMTFSI, abbreviated as EMT) ionic liquid is constructed. In the ternary system, EMIM + ‐TFSI − /OTf − ion pairs reconstruct the hydrogen‐bond network of the dual‐salt framework, thereby reducing bulk viscosity and broadening the electrochemical stability window to 2.76 V at low total salt concentrations. More importantly, these ion pairs undergo adsorption‐reduction‐anchoring to form an inner inorganic/outer organic bilayer, where OTf − /TFSI − decomposition generates a robust fluoride‐rich solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) that subsequently anchors EMIM + as a dynamic cationic shield. Consequently, the Zn//Zn symmetric cells achieve an outstanding lifespan of 3215 h at 1 mA cm −2. Zn//MnO 2 ‐CNT battery demonstrates 88.21% capacity retention after 1100 cycles at 1 A g −1 within a high‐voltage range (0.8–2.0 V), and Zn//LiMn 2 O 4 battery exhibits a high discharge plateau of 1.86 V v s. Zn. This work offers a promising electrolyte design strategy for high‐voltage and long‐cycle‐life AZMBs.
papers.summary_ko: 수계 아연 금속전지는 좁은 전기화학적 안정 전위창과 느린 반응속도로 에너지밀도가 제한된다. 본 연구는 Zn(OTf)2/LiOTf 이중염에 소량의 이온성 액체(EMIMTFSI)를 더한 삼원 하이브리드 전해질을 통해 전위창을 2.76V까지 넓히고 불소가 풍부한 SEI를 형성시켰다. Zn//Zn 대칭셀이 3215시간의 긴 수명을 보였고, Zn//LiMn2O4 전지는 1.86V의 높은 방전 전압평탄을 나타냈다.

papers.title: Ion‐Pair Decoupler Tunes Solvation Chemistry for Room‐Temperature Polymer Electrolytes With Built‐In Flame Retardancy
papers.abstract_en: Solid‐state polymer electrolytes for high‐energy lithium‐metal batteries are severely constrained by low room‐temperature ionic conductivity. However, mainstream approaches focus on regulating the aggregate structure and flexibility of polymer chains while neglecting the ionic solvation microenvironment, which caps ionic conductivity gains at a marginal level. Here, an innovative ion‐pair decoupling strategy is proposed to reshape the Li + solvation chemistry within polymer matrices and to facilitate rapid ionic conduction. The ion‐pair decoupler, diethyl phosphoramidate, promotes the dissociation of lithium salt into a configuration dominated by solvent‐separated ion pairs by coordinating with Li + via its electron‐rich P = O groups and anchoring TFSI ‒ through hydrogen bond donors. Consequently, the ionic conductivity of the engineered electrolyte increases 24.6‐fold at 25°C. Li symmetric cells achieve stable cycling over 850 h, and Li||LiFePO 4 cells deliver a high‐capacity retention rate of 96.5% after 400 cycles at 25°C. Furthermore, the designed electrolyte exhibits excellent self‐extinguishing flame‐retardant properties by combining gas‐phase radical scavenging and condensed‐phase char‐forming mechanisms. Thus, a single molecular design simultaneously serves as an ion‐pair decoupler and an intrinsic flame retardant, establishing solvation‐chemistry tuning as a new paradigm for safe, room‐temperature solid polymer electrolytes.
papers.summary_ko: 고체 고분자 전해질은 상온 이온전도도가 낮아 리튬금속전지 적용에 제약이 있다. 본 연구는 디에틸 포스포라미데이트를 이온쌍 분리제로 사용하여 Li+ 용매화 화학을 재구성, 용매분리이온쌍 비중을 높여 25°C 이온전도도를 24.6배 향상시켰다. Li 대칭셀이 850시간 안정적으로 작동했고 Li||LiFePO4 셀이 400사이클 후 96.5% 용량유지율을 보였으며, 동시에 자기소화형 난연성도 구현했다.

papers.title: In Situ Polymerized Interfaces Enable Robust and High‐Performance Dry‐Coating Electrodes
papers.abstract_en: Dry‐coating electrode technology eliminates the use of toxic N‐methyl‐2‐pyrrolidone and offers a promising route for sustainable battery manufacturing. However, its practical implementation remains limited by the weak interfacial mechanics among rigid cathode particles, polytetrafluoroethylene nanofibers, and conductive carbon additives. These fragile interfaces reduce mechanical robustness and interfacial stability, thereby compromising both processability and electrochemical performance. Here, we report an in situ polymerization strategy using a polymerizable deep eutectic liquid additive, which forms an adhesive polymer network upon photopolymerization, thereby reinforcing contact among electrode components and improving electrode robustness. The resulting dry‐coating LiNi 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 (NCM811) electrodes exhibit a 55% increase in elongation at break and deliver a reversible specific capacity of 121 mAh g −1 at 5 C with a mass loading of 10 mg cm −2. A 3.77 Ah Li||NCM811 pouch cell achieves maximum cell‐level energy and power densities of 412 Wh kg −1 and 574 W kg −1, respectively. In addition, a 0.60 Ah graphite||NCM811 pouch cell retains 70% of its capacity after 870 cycles. Our results establish in situ polymerization as a viable route for mechanically robust, high‐performance dry‐coating electrodes.
papers.summary_ko: 드라이코팅 전극 기술은 독성 NMP를 사용하지 않지만 전극 구성요소 간 약한 계면 결합이 문제다. 본 연구는 광중합형 공융 액체 첨가제를 이용한 in-situ 중합 전략으로 전극 성분 간 접착성 고분자 네트워크를 형성시켜 NCM811 드라이코팅 전극의 파단 신율을 55% 향상시켰다. 3.77Ah Li||NCM811 파우치셀이 412 Wh/kg의 에너지밀도를 달성했고, 그래파이트||NCM811 셀은 870사이클 후 70% 용량을 유지했다.

papers.title: In Situ Formation of Inorganic‐Rich Interphase via SiO 2 Additive for High‐Performance Sodium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Sodium metal batteries (SMBs) are promising candidates for next‐generation high‐energy‐density storage systems, yet their practical application is hindered by dendritic growth and unstable solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) formation. Herein, we report an in situ interfacial regulation strategy by introducing amorphous SiO 2 (a‑SiO 2) into Na metal anodes through an accumulative roll bonding process. We reveal that SiO 2 undergoes electrochemical reduction reaction with Na, generating SiO x (1<x<2) and Na 2 O—a beneficial inorganic SEI component that enhances interfacial ion transport and mechanical robustness. Furthermore, a‐SiO 2 exhibits superior interfacial reactivity and strong adsorption affinity toward fluoroethylene carbonate (FEC), promoting a NaF‐rich SEI that suppresses electrolyte decomposition. This synergetic inorganic‐rich SEI homogenizes Na deposition and accelerates ion diffusion kinetics. As a result, the Na/a‑SiO 2 symmetric cell achieves an ultralow overpotential of 24 mV at 0.5 mA cm −2 and stable cycling for over 1350 h. When paired with the Na 3 V 2 (PO 4) 2 O 2 F cathode, the full cell delivers excellent rate capability (73.9 mAh g −1 at 60 C) and cycling stability with 80% capacity retention after 8000 cycles at 20 C. This work establishes SiO 2 as a scalable and effective inorganic additive for tailoring SEI chemistry, offering a practical pathway toward high‐energy and durable SMBs.
papers.summary_ko: 소듐 금속전지는 덴드라이트 성장과 불안정한 SEI 형성이 문제다. 본 연구는 누적압연접합 공정으로 비정질 SiO2를 Na 금속 음극에 도입, 전기화학적 환원반응으로 SiOx와 이온전달에 유리한 Na2O를 생성하고 FEC와의 반응성을 높여 NaF가 풍부한 SEI를 형성시켰다. Na/a-SiO2 대칭셀은 24mV의 낮은 과전위로 1350시간 이상 안정 사이클링했고, Na3V2(PO4)2O2F 양극과의 풀셀은 8000사이클 후 80% 용량을 유지했다.

papers.title: Dynamic Li+/Na+-Exchanging Interphase Stabilizes High-Voltage Ni-Rich Cathodes for 557 Wh kg–1 Lithium Batteries
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: High-voltage operation of Ni-rich layered cathodes LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2 (NCM811) accelerates electrolyte decomposition at the surface and destabilizes the bulk lattice with oxygen loss. Conventional strategies for regulating the cathode–electrolyte interphase (CEI) commonly suppress persistent parasitic reactions at Ni-rich cathode surfaces, but increase interfacial polarization and offer limited protection against structural degradation in the bulk. Here, a dynamic interphase is constructed by coating NCM811 with a Na+-based solid-electrolyte Na3Zr2Si2PO12 (NZSP). During cycling, Li+/Na+ exchange transforms the NZSP layer into a fast Li+ conducting interphase LixNa3–xZr2Si2PO12 (L-NZSP), while the Na+ ions are incorporated into the NCM811 lattice. The L-NZSP suppresses parasitic reactions at high charging voltages. Meanwhile, the incorporated Na+ ions provide pillar-like support for the layered framework, stabilizing the oxygen lattice and mitigating chemo-mechanical degradation. Consequently, the modified cathode retains 80% capacity after 511 cycles at 4.7 V and enables a 4 Ah pouch cell to deliver 557 Wh kg–1 with 80.5% retention over 118 cycles. This work demonstrates Li+/Na+-exchanging interphase as an effective strategy to couple interfacial protection with bulk lattice reinforcement for high-voltage Ni-rich cathodes in high-energy lithium batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 고전압에서 작동하는 Ni-rich NCM811 양극은 표면 전해질 분해와 산소 손실에 의한 벌크 구조 불안정화가 문제다. 본 연구는 NCM811 표면에 Na+계 고체전해질 NZSP를 코팅, 사이클링 중 Li+/Na+ 교환으로 빠른 Li+ 전도성 계면(L-NZSP)으로 전환되면서 Na+가 격자에 박혀 층상구조를 지지하는 동적 계면을 구현했다. 그 결과 4.7V에서 511사이클 후 80% 용량유지율을 보였고 4Ah 파우치셀이 557 Wh/kg 에너지밀도를 달성했다.

papers.title: Cross-Linked Halide Networks for Lithium Superionic Conduction
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: All-solid-state batteries (ASSBs) hold great promise for next-generation energy storage owing to their high safety and energy density, yet their performance critically depends on solid electrolytes (SEs) with high ionic conductivity and structural robustness. Mixed-anion chemistry, exemplified by the Cl/O system, has emerged as an effective approach for designing halide-based superionic conductors, where partial oxygen incorporation distorts the regular halide framework and enhances Li+ mobility. However, we herein show that uncontrolled oxygen incorporation is prone to generate nonbridging oxygens (NBOs), which can hinder Li+ migration via Coulombic interactions. To address this, we develop a polyanion-assisted cross-linking strategy that promotes more bridging-oxygen (BOs) coordination and less formation of NBOs. This yields a highly disordered, frustrated energy landscape conducive to efficient Li+ percolation and rapid ion migration. As an example, PO43– polyanion cross-linked ZrClx halide networks (ZrCl4-xLi3PO4) are developed and exhibit ionic conductivities up to 2.8 × 10–3 S cm–1 at 30 °C, competitive with state-of-the-art rare-metal halides, while maintaining >10–3 S cm–1 after humid exposure (5% RH, 12 h). ASSBs incorporating these electrolytes demonstrate stable cycling not only under elevated temperatures (55 °C) but also under high voltages (4.6 V). These findings identify NBO environments as potential transport inhibitors and establish inorganic cross-linking topochemistry as a structural design principle for robust, high-performance, halide solid electrolytes.
papers.summary_ko: 전고체전지용 할라이드계 고체전해질에서 산소 혼입 시 생성되는 비가교 산소(NBO)가 Li+ 이동을 저해하는 문제를 해결하기 위해, 폴리인산 가교 전략으로 가교산소(BO) 비중을 높인 ZrCl4-xLi3PO4 할라이드 네트워크를 개발했다. 30°C에서 2.8×10⁻³ S/cm의 이온전도도와 습윤 노출 후에도 10⁻³ S/cm 이상을 유지했으며, 55°C 및 4.6V 고전압에서도 안정적인 전고체전지 사이클링을 구현했다.

papers.title: Asymmetric Partial Hydrogenation of Quinazolines: Overcoming Catalyst Poisoning by a Robust yet Active Solo-Coordination-Vacant Ir(III) Pincer Catalyst
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: Catalytic asymmetric partial hydrogenation of quinazolines to afford enantioenriched 3,4-dihydroquinazolines, a privileged scaffold in medicinal chemistry, is a long-standing challenge likely due to product-induced catalyst deactivation. Here, we report a robust yet highly reactive solo-coordination-vacant Ir(III) pincer catalyst being capable of overcoming this poisoning challenge. This catalyst enables the asymmetric partial hydrogenation of a broad range of quinazolines, affording 3,4-dihydroquinazolines in high yields (up to 98%) and excellent enantioselectivities (up to 99% ee). In a dedicated catalyst-loading study, the loading could be reduced to 0.001 mol % (10 ppm, TON = 38,000). Mechanistic investigations, including NMR spectroscopic detection of a key Ir–H intermediate and base-dependence studies, support a catalytic cycle proceeding through a well-defined Ir(III)-hydride species and suggest that an alkali-metal-assisted pathway is unlikely to be dominant.
papers.summary_ko: 퀴나졸린의 비대칭 부분수소화 반응에서 생성물에 의한 촉매 피독 문제를 해결하는 Ir(III) 핀셋 촉매를 개발한 유기합성화학 논문으로, 배터리와는 무관하다.

papers.title: A Cu-Modified Layered Thiostannate for Selective Pb Capture from Strongly Acidic Media
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: Layered metal sulfide ion exchangers are powerful platforms for soft-metal capture, but their application in strongly acidic environments requires framework stability while preserving accessible ion-exchange pathways. Here, we introduce a new series of Cu-modified SnS2-derived layered chalcogenides, AMS-8 (A = Na, K, Rb, Cs), featuring labile interlayer alkali metal ions. NMS-8 (Na1.13Cu1.32Sn3.34S8·xH2O) demonstrates that Cu+ can be incorporated into the SnS2-derived AMS layered motif without disrupting the fundamental architecture. Upon acid exposure, NMS-8 undergoes Na+/H+ exchange and interlayer contraction, showing low Sn leaching in 6 M H2SO4 but substantial Sn dissolution in 6 M HCl after prolonged exposure, despite persistent powder X-ray diffraction reflections of the layered phase. NMS-8 can rapidly capture Pb2+ from water, achieving near-complete removal within 20 s under dilute conditions, a Sips-fitted capacity of 178.2 ± 12.4 mg g–1 (regression standard error), and high selectivity against common competing cations. Structural characterization supports preservation of the lamellar network and a proposed structural model featuring Cu+ displaced off-center within a distorted octahedral framework environment. In an acid mine drainage simulant, NMS-8 selectively removes Pb, Cd, and Cu under acidic multicomponent conditions while retaining its layered structure. Local structural characterization of NMS-8@Pb reveals a spatially heterogeneous Pb distribution within individual crystallites that is not appropriately described by a simple homogeneous interlayer exchange model and is consistent with local structural reorganization during Pb2+ uptake. These results highlight Cu-modified layered thiostannates as promising platforms for rapid, selective soft-metal capture, with substantial resistance to concentrated sulfuric acid and Pb retention dependent on the leaching medium.
papers.summary_ko: 강산성 환경에서 Pb2+를 선택적으로 포집하는 Cu 개질 층상 티오주석산염(AMS-8) 이온교환체를 개발한 연구로, 배터리 전극과는 무관한 중금속 흡착/정화 소재 논문이다.

papers.title: d 5 ‐Probed Interlocked Charge‐Structural Disorder Enables Deep Mn 3+ /Mn 2+ Redox Chemistry in Layered Oxide Cathodes
papers.abstract_en: Mn‐based layered oxide cathodes are attractive for next‐generation rechargeable batteries, owing to their abundant resources and rich redox chemistry, but achieving reversible deep Mn 3+ /Mn 2+ redox remains challenging. Herein, we developed an interlocked charge‐structural disorder protocol in P2‐derived Na 0.67 Fe 0.1 Mn 0.9 O 2 to regulate Mn redox and stabilize discharge voltage. A disordered cation framework is engineered through electronic configuration and atomic rearrangement, where Fe 3+ (d 5, half‐filled) breaks charge periodicity, and rapid quenching prevents structural reordering to eliminate Fe/Mn order. Electron energy‐loss spectroscopy (EELS) reveals suppressed Mn 4+ /Mn 3+ charge ordering, which enables extended Mn 3+ /Mn 2+ redox as confirmed by soft x‐ray absorption spectroscopy (sXAS). The optimized cathode quenched at 700°C nearly doubles the Mn 3+ /Mn 2+ redox contribution within the Mg‐compatible window (1.8–1.6 V vs. Mg 2+ /Mg) from 15.2% to 29.4%, and it delivers 291.3 Wh kg −1 energy density (based on the mass of active cathode) with capacity retention increased from 62.4% to 87.5% over 50 cycles. Mechanistically, the interlocked disorder lowers the migration barrier by flattening the electrostatic‐potential landscape and enhances the thermodynamic driving force for Mn 3+ /Mn 2+ by destabilizing Jahn–Teller correlations. This work establishes charge‐state disorder as a versatile design principle for layered oxide cathodes, enabling deep, reversible transition‐metal redox for advanced energy storage.
papers.summary_ko: Mn 기반 층상 산화물 양극은 자원이 풍부하지만 깊은 Mn3+/Mn2+ 환원반응의 가역성 확보가 어렵다. 본 연구는 P2형 Na0.67Fe0.1Mn0.9O2에서 Fe3+의 반충전된 d5 전자구조로 전하 주기성을 깨고 급속 냉각으로 양이온 무질서를 유도, Mn4+/Mn3+ 전하 질서를 억제하여 Mn3+/Mn2+ 환원반응 기여도를 15.2%에서 29.4%로 거의 두 배 높였다. 700°C에서 급냉한 최적 양극은 291.3 Wh/kg 에너지밀도와 50사이클 후 87.5%의 향상된 용량유지율을 보였다.

papers.title: PFAS‐Free Localized High‐Concentration Gel Polymer Electrolytes for Ambient Temperature Li‐Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Impregnating localized high‐concentration liquid electrolytes into in situ polymerized matrices to form localized high‐concentration gel polymer electrolytes (LHC‐GPEs) is emerging as a commercially viable alternative to both conventional liquid electrolytes and solid polymer electrolytes for room‐temperature Li‐metal batteries. However, LHC‐GPEs often rely on fluorinated diluents and polymeric components to achieve compatibility with high‐voltage cathode materials. Herein, we investigate perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS)‐free LHC‐GPEs based on toluene as a non‐fluorinated diluent and non‐fluorinated polymeric matrices. Their physico‐chemical properties are elucidated through experimental characterization and molecular dynamics simulations. We then studied electrochemical performance in Li||Li and LiNi 0.8 Mn 0.1 Co 0.1 O 2 (NMC‐811)||Li cells under practically relevant conditions, including a C/3 charge‐discharge rate, cycling at 25°C, and NMC‐811 areal loading of 3 mAh·cm −2. The optimized LHC‐GPE formulation delivers a capacity retention of ≈ 90% over 200 cycles (with 500 µm thick lithium metal anode, LMA) or 100 cycles (with 20 µm thick LMA on 8 µm thin Cu current collector). Interestingly, the LHC‐GPE exhibited a longer cycle life than cells with similar liquid electrolyte composition, demonstrating the utility of the gel polymer electrolyte approach. This study demonstrates the suitability of environmentally friendly LHC‐GPEs for Li‐metal batteries, enabled by the use of fluorine‐free diluents and polymer‐based components.
papers.summary_ko: 기존 국부고농도 젤고분자전해질(LHC-GPE)은 불화 희석제와 고분자에 의존하는 한계가 있어, 본 연구는 톨루엔 기반 비불화 PFAS-free LHC-GPE를 개발하여 상온 리튬금속전지에 적용했다. Li||NMC811 셀에서 C/3, 25°C 조건으로 500µm 리튬금속 음극 사용 시 200사이클, 20µm 박막 리튬 사용 시 100사이클에서 약 90% 용량유지율을 달성했다.

papers.title: Medium‐Entropy O3‐Type Layered Oxide as a High‐Performance and Air‐Stable Cathode Material for Sodium‐Ion Batteries: Investigation of Sn Doping to Enhance Cycling Stability
papers.abstract_en: O3‐type layered oxides are attractive cathode materials for sodium‐ion batteries (SIBs) but suffer from rapid capacity decay due to severe phase transitions and air/moisture sensitivity. Herein, NaLi 0.05 Ni 0.3 Mn 0.5−x Cu 0.1 Mg 0.05 Sn x O 2 was synthesized via spray drying. Sn incorporation induced strong Sn─O bonding and enlarged interlayer spacing, improving structural stability and electrochemical kinetics, building upon the medium‐entropy stabilization already conferred by the multi‐element base composition. The optimized NaLi 0.05 Ni 0.3 Mn 0.47 Cu 0.1 Mg 0.05 Sn 0.03 O 2 (x = 0.03; Sn0.03) delivered a reversible capacity of 142 mAh g −1 (at 0.1 C), 83% capacity retention after 500 cycles at 1 C, and excellent rate capability (98 mAh g −1 at 30 C). Operando synchrotron x‐ray diffraction and x‐ray absorption spectroscopy confirmed that Sn doping suppresses the O3 to P’3 phase transition, effectively mitigating lattice distortion and enhancing cycling performance. The reversible redox reactions of Ni 2+ /Ni 4+ and Cu 2+ /Cu 3+ compensated the charge, while electrochemically inactive Mn 4+ and Sn 4+ stabilized the structure. Sn doping improved structural integrity, maintaining electrochemical performance after water immersion and air exposure. A Sn0.03//hard carbon full cell exhibited a competitively high energy density of 261.9 Wh kg −1. Density functional theory calculations corroborated delayed phase transitions and enhanced air/moisture stability. These findings establish Sn0.03 as a potential cathode candidate for practical SIB applications.
papers.summary_ko: O3형 층상산화물은 소듐이온전지 양극재로 유망하지만 상전이와 대기/수분 민감성으로 급격한 용량 저하가 문제다. 본 연구는 분무건조법으로 Sn을 도핑한 NaLi0.05Ni0.3Mn0.5-xCu0.1Mg0.05SnxO2를 합성, Sn-O 결합과 확장된 층간 거리로 O3→P'3 상전이를 억제했다. 최적 조성(x=0.03)은 0.1C에서 142 mAh/g, 1C 500사이클 후 83% 용량유지율, 하드카본 풀셀에서 261.9 Wh/kg의 에너지밀도를 달성했으며 수분/대기 노출 후에도 안정성을 유지했다.

papers.title: Highly Adaptable Electrochemical Lithium Extraction From Brine via Heterojunction Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Electrochemical lithium extraction from salt‐lake brines has received extensive attention due to its low energy consumption, environmental friendliness, and high efficiency. However, conventional electrode materials suffer from sluggish desolvation kinetics and competing cations intercalation (Na +) in the diverse brine environment across the world. Herein, a heterojunction engineering strategy was proposed to solve the above challenges. A lithium titanium oxides (LTO) heterojunction was rationally designed and constructed on the surface of LiFePO 4 (named LFP‐SEF), which could expedite the desolvation process of Li + via the induced built‐in electric field and suppress competing cation intercalation via size sieving. Consequently, the LFP‐SEF‐based device consistently delivers outstanding lithium extraction performance in a series of brines (Na/Li ≈ 1–150) around the world. Even in the brine from southern Tibet (Dangxiongcuo Salt Lake) with a high Na/Li mass ratio of 150, LFP‐SEF also exhibits 83.72% capacity retention after 50 cycles with high separation factor (Na/Li ≈ 989.80; Mg/Li ≈1856.50). The exceptional performance is preserved as the device size increases from lab‐scale to production‐scale (1.5 m 2), demonstrating its excellent industrialization prospects. The concept of heterojunction engineering proposed in this work opens a promising route to industrial‐scale lithium extraction in complex brine environment.
papers.summary_ko: 염호 브라인에서의 전기화학적 리튬 추출을 위해 LiFePO4 표면에 리튬티탄산화물(LTO) 이종접합을 구성한 전극(LFP-SEF)을 개발, 내부 전기장으로 Li+ 탈용매화를 촉진하고 크기 선별로 경쟁 양이온(Na+) 삽입을 억제했다. Na/Li 비율이 150에 달하는 티베트 당슝춰 염호 브라인에서도 50사이클 후 83.72%의 용량유지율과 높은 Na/Li 분리계수(989.80)를 보였으며, 1.5m² 생산 규모까지 성능이 유지됨을 입증했다.

papers.title: Decoding Direct Regeneration of Spent LiFePO 4: From Defect Evolution to Thermodynamic–Kinetic Barrier Engineering
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of LiFePO 4 (LFP) batteries has made the sustainable recycling of spent cathodes increasingly important for the battery circular economy. Direct regeneration has emerged as the most promising strategy because it preserves the pristine framework, minimizes energy consumption, and maximizes material value. However, the underlying principles governing regeneration remain elusive, as exemplified by the apparent thermodynamic‐kinetic paradox that metallic lithium has been reported to be ineffective for restoring spent LFP, whereas weaker reductants can achieve effective recovery. These observations indicate that regeneration is governed not by thermodynamic driving force alone, but by the coupled effects of electron transfer, ion diffusion, and lattice defects. In this study, we introduce a multiscale defect framework that correlates defect formation energy (Δ H f), migration barriers (E a), and electron‐transfer reorganization energy (λ) with different degradation states of spent LFP. A hypothesis that the dominant barrier evolves with degradation was proposed, enabling failure‐dependent strategies ranging from relithiation and phase‐boundary engineering to defect‐guided upcycling. By transforming regeneration from empirical optimization into rational barrier engineering, this perspective provides a unified understanding of diverse restoration pathways. Finally, emerging challenges, including impurity management, AI‐assisted diagnostics, and closed‐loop materials design, are discussed to guide the development of sustainable battery recycling technologies.
papers.summary_ko: 폐LiFePO4(LFP) 양극의 직접 재생은 순환경제 관점에서 중요하지만, 금속 리튬이 재생에 비효율적인 반면 약한 환원제가 효과적인 열역학-속도론적 역설이 존재한다. 본 연구는 결함형성에너지, 이동장벽, 전자전달 재구성에너지를 결합한 다중스케일 결함 프레임워크를 제시하여 열화 상태에 따라 지배적 장벽이 달라짐을 보이고, 재용리튬화부터 결함기반 업사이클링까지 열화 단계별 전략을 제안한 리뷰/관점 논문이다.

papers.title: A Novel Metal‐Hydrogen‐Bonded Organic Framework (M‐HOF) Cathode Material for High‐Performance Lithium–Sulfur Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Lithium-sulfur (Li-S) batteries (LSBs) are highly promising for next-generation energy storage devices, yet their practical application is hindered by severe polysulfide shuttling and sluggish sulfur conversion kinetics. Herein, a novel metal-containing hydrogen-bonded organic framework (HOF-21) is constructed and integrated with carbon nanotubes and sulfur as cathode for Li-S batteries. The synergistic combination of hydrogen-bonding networks and Cu coordination sites enables strong polysulfide anchoring and accelerates sulfur redox conversion. Experimental characterizations and theoretical calculations reveal that the unique framework structure containing metals and rich abundant hydrogen bonds effectively immobilizes soluble lithium polysulfides, while Cu active centers induce interfacial electronic coupling and optimize the thermodynamic conversion pathway of sulfur species. Benefiting from the adsorption-catalysis synergistic regulation, the HOF-21/CNT@S cathode exhibits enhanced reaction kinetics, suppressed polysulfide migration, and improved interfacial stability. As a result, the assembled HOF-21/CNT@S battery delivers excellent long-term cycling stability with a capacity decay rate of only 0.06% per cycle over 500 cycles at 2 C at room temperature. Moreover, it maintains outstanding low-temperature adaptability, achieving 76.8% capacity retention after 200 cycles at -10°C and 90.6% retention after 200 cycles at -20°C. This work provides a promising strategy for designing advanced cathode materials toward high-energy-density Li-S batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬-황전지는 폴리설파이드 셔틀링과 느린 황 전환 반응속도가 실용화의 걸림돌이다. 본 연구는 Cu를 포함한 수소결합 유기프레임워크(HOF-21)를 탄소나노튜브 및 황과 결합한 양극을 구성, 수소결합 네트워크와 Cu 배위자리가 폴리설파이드를 강하게 고정하고 황 전환을 촉진함을 보였다. HOF-21/CNT@S 양극은 2C에서 500사이클간 사이클당 0.06%의 낮은 용량감쇄율을 보였고 -20°C에서도 90.6%의 용량유지율을 나타냈다.
